candidate_program.name: occupancy_efficiency
candidate_program.rationale: Ranks reward per approximate duration-plus-gap occupancy, discounted by the blocked residual fraction. Uses root resource values and degree context with constant-size arithmetic; overlapping gap effects make occupancy only a proxy.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + duration + station_gap + satellite_gap) * (1 - degree / (1 + remaining_count))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
